summary.text: Jay Schroeder, a Republican, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Secretary of State of Wisconsin to JoCasta Zamarripa.

He campaigned on eliminating the bipartisan Wisconsin Elections Commission and moving election administration to the Secretary of State, which would require new legislation, and described himself as an "authentic MAGA activist."

paragraphs.text: Jay Schroeder was born and raised in Clintonville, Wisconsin.
His campaign site describes him as a husband, father and business leader.
Schroeder was the Republican nominee for Secretary of State in 2018, when he lost to Doug La Follette, and he finished second to Amy Loudenbeck in the 2022 Republican primary.
His 2026 platform called for moving the role of chief election official from the Wisconsin Elections Commission, created in 2016, to the Secretary of State, along with stronger records transparency.
He received 45.6% of the vote to JoCasta Zamarripa's 50.6%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
